name: Stonetalon Mountains
summary: In Stonetalon Mountains, sacred heights now face smoke, deforestation, and elemental ruin. Night elves and tauren revere the range, while border hostilities simmer below.

sections.title: The Ill Winds and the Peaks
sections.body: Stonetalon Mountains rise from central Kalimdor beneath the Ill Winds. Moisture from the western seas brings sudden downpours and slick sandstone trails, while fierce gusts scour the lower valleys, blinding travelers with grit and hurling the careless from cliffs. Higher ridges carry evergreen forests around Stonetalon Peak. Night elves tend ancestral barrows and glades there, and watch sacred wyvern and hippogryph roosts along Mirkfallon Lake.

sections.title: Industry and Intrusion
sections.body: The Venture Company has broken the range's quiet with logging camps and strip mines in Windshear Crag. The goblins, aided by the deranged leper gnome Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, have felled old-growth timber, filled the skies with furnace smoke, and fouled mountain runoff with industrial sludge. Local shamans from Orgrimmar answered the mountain spirits' cries. Small Alliance camps nearby also resist the defilers and try to protect the highlands that remain.

sections.title: Scars of the Past
sections.body: South lies the Charred Vale, once a blossoming wilderness and now an ash-covered wasteland filled with rogue fire elementals, black dragonspawn, and harpies. During the Third War, the Horde and Alliance forged an uneasy truce in these peaks under the mysterious Oracle's guidance. Relations have since frayed. Renegade Grimtotem tauren hold seized encampments, while Darkspear trolls in Malaka'jin clash with Alliance forces pressing out from the Barrens and Ashenvale.

faq.q: How do I get to the Stonetalon Mountains?
faq.answer: Most travelers reach Stonetalon Mountains through Talondeep Pass, a mountain trail from southwestern Ashenvale. High trails lead south into Desolace, and routes descend east into the northern Barrens.

faq.q: Why is the Charred Vale burned and ruined?
faq.answer: The Charred Vale was once a lush haven, but cataclysmic devastation consumed it in flames. Now the valley is an ash-covered ruin crawling with aggressive fire elementals, rogue drakes, and deadly harpies.

faq.q: What is the Venture Company doing in Windshear Crag?
faq.answer: The Venture Company cuts timber and mines deep into Windshear Crag for mineral wealth. Its operations have fouled Cragpool Lake with engine grease, stripped the valleys bare, and enraged local spirits and native inhabitants.

faq.q: Where are the main flight masters located?
faq.answer: Alliance heroes use the flight master at Stonetalon Peak's high sanctuary in the north. Horde adventurers rely on the central mountain village of Sun Rock Retreat.

faq.q: What happened at Stonetalon Peak during the Third War?
faq.answer: During the Third War, Thrall and Jaina Proudmoore followed visions of the Prophet Medivh through Stonetalon Peak's caverns in search of the Oracle. There they forged a temporary alliance against the Burning Legion at Mount Hyjal.

faq.q: Who are the Grimtotem in Stonetalon?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem are a renegade tauren tribe hostile to outsider influence. In Stonetalon, they occupy a mountain post near the Barrens border, terrorize travelers, and take prisoners.

angles.text: Horde adventurers rely on Sun Rock Retreat and Malaka'jin, the southern troll post, to curb Venture Company pollution and root out Grimtotem outlaws.
From Stonetalon Peak and hidden camps around Windshear Crag, the Alliance defends ancient kaldorei barrows against goblin machines and territorial rivals.
Windshear Crag's desecration and the Charred Vale's scorched corruption call druids to soothe enraged nature spirits and protect sacred roosts.
Goblin drills assault the mountain spirits, whose cries reach Orgrimmar. Shamans answer the call to quell rampaging rock elementals and restore balance to the peaks.
